rationale: Darren brings 30 years of e-commerce and infrastructure experience plus deep conviction around privacy-preserving blockchain architecture for platforms that mainstream payments processors reject—exactly the kind of infrastructure-first thinking Elias values in building for the current technological moment. Both are San Francisco founders solving problems at the intersection of emerging tech and real-world operations, and Darren's track record scaling KinkBNB across physical + digital channels could offer operational perspective as Elias scales Lee-AI.
intro_message: Darren Mckeeman, meet Elias Schwalme — you're both SF founders obsessed with infrastructure for the current era, and Darren's experience building privacy-first platforms on blockchain while managing physical operations might offer useful patterns for scaling consumer AI products.
